name: Material Expressive Inspired
description: An independent interpretation of Material Design's public expressive principles: a bold shape scale, with 16px square-shouldered controls, 48px containers, arched media and 12px chips, containment in tone with heavier outlines, level 2 elevation under cards and level 4 under overlays, 56px controls with roomy padding, heavy icons, a 3px ring, and spatial springs that overshoot and squash on press. It ships no official component, token file, icon, or font.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, after Material Design's public principles. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's organic-material recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
caveats: Expressive state motion: presses squash more than in a quiet language.
Its focus ring is 3px, not the prototype's 2px: at 2px, its rounded corners leave the ring short of the area a 2px ring covers at 3:1.
Its enter motion, spring-in, and emphasis motion, bounce-once, have no keyframes in the platform yet, so they don't animate.

tokens.shadow-card: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 2px 6px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 15%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-overlay: 0 2px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 6px 10px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 15%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: 0 2px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 6px 10px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 15%, transparent)
